purpose: Freeze the user problem, promise, journey, tagline, and description for JP-BW7.
problem: Job seekers are overwhelmed by scattered listings, repetitive searches, long job descriptions, and uncertainty about which roles deserve their limited application time.
promise: JobPilot brings fresh nearby roles together, compares them with your resume, explains which opportunities deserve your time, and takes you directly to the employer’s application page.
tagline: Know why a job fits before you apply.
description: JobPilot helps application-fatigued job seekers move from scattered listings to confident applications by bringing nearby roles together, comparing them with a resume, explaining the fit, and linking directly to the employer’s application page.
